# ProposalRead

`schemas/api/proposal.json`

One record of GET /v1/proposals (docs/design/m0/04 "Proposals and confirmation"): what a proposal binds and where it stands, in every state. Its project is the one derived server side when it was proposed (null: installation-wide, read only under an every-project read). Never its scope, the command's raw input, nor a digest that may depend on input it withholds: its binding digest, its expected state, or its object's content digest (a proposal.confirm's object is another proposal, scope and all).
